headline: Renewed Fighting Stirs Contested Base Lines
war_summary: The latest ledger records a sharper contest on several divided fronts, while many quieter sectors remain unchanged. StonecradleHex is now the liveliest base sector, with five events in the past two hours and sixteen in twenty-four; its line stands at six Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base, amid heavy and accelerating casualty traffic. WeatheredExpanseHex follows with three recent and nineteen daily events, its five-Warden, four-Colonial division facing accelerating losses and enlistments on both sides. LinnMercyHex has eased from its earlier pace but still shows sixteen daily events, two recent, and one neutral base among ten Colonial holdings. StlicanShelfHex has also quickened, posting two events in two hours and nine in a day around a five-Warden, four-Colonial split. DeadLandsHex saw five daily events, including competing captures, but its front is presently quiet and all eleven bases are Colonial-held. MooringCountyHex logged eight daily events, though none in the last six hours. Elsewhere, heavy fighting is visible in Callahans Passage without recorded base events.
